enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over onto one side. Pull the blanket up. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over onto the other side. Remain lying on the bed until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water from the cup. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread on the counter. Pick up a plate from the cabinet. Put the bread on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Put the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch to boil water. Open the microwave door. Put the plate with bread inside. Close the microwave door. Press the start button. Wait for the beep. Open the microwave door. Take out the plate. Close the microwave door. Sit down at the table. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Pick up the cup. Pour coffee into the cup. Add milk to the cup. Stir the coffee with a spoon. Drink the coffee. Put the cup down on the table. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and checking the storm forecast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work clothes. Take off the pajamas. Put on the work shirt. Put on the work pants. Put on the socks. Put on the shoes. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the power button. Unlock the phone. Open the weather app. Scroll through the storm forecast. Read the forecast details. Close the weather app. Lock the phone. Put the phone into the pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of Bedroom 1. Walk to the front door. Pick up the bag from the hook. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the front door. Lock the front door with the key. Put the key into the pocket. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the phone. Check the time on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Hold the handrail. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the exit door. Step off the bus. Walk to the hospital entrance. Push open the hospital door. Walk to the staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Change into the work uniform. Put on the ID badge. Pick up the clipboard. Walk to the patient room. Push open the door. Greet the patient. Check the patient's vital signs. Wrap the blood pressure cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the blood pressure reading. Write the reading on the chart. Remove the cuff from the patient's arm. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Wait for the beep. Read the temperature. Write the temperature on the chart. Put the thermometer back in the holder. Adjust the IV drip rate. Check the IV line. Hang a new IV bag on the pole. Enter the medication data into the computer. Press the keyboard keys. Click the mouse. Print the medication record. Pick up the printed page. Walk to the nurses' station. Hand the page to the colleague. Discuss the patient's condition with the colleague. Pick up the phone. Call the pharmacy. Speak to the pharmacist about the prescription. Hang up the phone. Walk back to the patient room. Assist the patient to sit up. Adjust the pillow. Assist the patient to lie back down. Walk to the supply room. Open the cabinet. Take out the gauze and bandages. Close the cabinet. Carry the supplies to the patient room. Change the patient's dressing. Discard the used gauze into the bin. Wash hands at the sink. Dry hands with paper towels. Walk back to the nurses' station. Sit down at the desk. Type the patient notes on the computer. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the next patient room.

Walk to the staff room. Change out of the work uniform. Put on the personal coat. Pick up the bag. Walk to the hospital exit. Push open the door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the phone. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a seat. Hold the handrail. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the exit door. Step off the bus. Walk to the apartment building. Open the building door. Walk up the stairs. Walk to the apartment door. Unlock the door with the key. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the knife down. Pick up the meat. Put the meat on the cutting board. Cut the meat into pieces. Put the knife down. Pick up the pot. Fill the pot with water from the tap. Put the pot on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Press the heat setting button. Wait for the water to boil. Pick up the vegetables. Put the vegetables into the pot. Pick up the meat. Put the meat into the pot. Pick up the spoon. Stir the soup. Pick up the lid. Put the lid on the pot. Wait for the soup to cook. Open the cabinet door. Take out a bowl. Close the cabinet door. Pick up the ladle. Scoop the soup into the bowl. Put the ladle down. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit down at the table. Pick up the spoon. Eat the soup. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the vegetables and meat. Put the chopsticks down. Stand up. Carry the bowl to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plate from the table. Carry the plate to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate under the water. Turn off the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Put the plate on the rack. Pick up the bowl. Rinse the bowl under the tap. Put the bowl on the rack. Pick up the spoon. Put the spoon in the cutlery basket. Pick up the chopsticks. Put the chopsticks in the cutlery basket. Pick up the cup. Rinse the cup. Put the cup on the rack. Push the lower rack back in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the power button on the dishwasher. Press the start button. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring out the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Running a load of laundry in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the laundry basket. Open the washing machine door. Take the clothes out of the basket. Put the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Pour fabric softener into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Press the program selection button. Press the start button. Listen to the water filling the drum. Pick up the empty basket. Put the basket back in the corner. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Pick up the remote control from the coffee table. Press the power button on the remote control. Point the remote control at the TV. Press the channel button. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushions. Put the remote control on the sofa armrest. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume up button. Put the remote control down. Cross the legs on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the phone screen. Lock the phone. Put the phone down on the coffee table. Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button. Put the remote control down. Watch the TV screen. Stretch the arms. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the empty cup from the coffee table. Carry the cup to the kitchen. Put the cup in the sink. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up. Turn off the living room light. Walk out of the living room.

Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Wait for the water to heat. Open the shower door. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Open the shower door. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Put on the bathrobe. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Charging the phone and computer and setting out a flashlight in case the storm causes a power outage
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the phone. Plug the charging cable into the phone. Plug the other end of the cable into the wall outlet. Put the phone on the nightstand. Pick up the computer. Open the desk drawer. Take out the computer charger. Close the desk drawer. Plug the charger into the computer. Plug the charger into the wall outlet. Put the computer on the desk. Open the nightstand drawer. Take out the flashlight. Close the nightstand drawer. Press the flashlight switch to test it. Press the switch again to turn it off. Put the flashlight on the nightstand. Turn off the bedroom light.

Take off the bathrobe. Put on the pajamas. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto one side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over onto the other side. Remain lying on the bed until asleep.
